description: Step 3/3 for writes: runs a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE operation described by describe_operation. Can create, change or delete data within the API key scopes: requires confirm=true after explicit user confirmation. An Idempotency-Key is generated unless one is passed in headers; reuse it only to retry the exact same request.

body.description: JSON body, or the text fields of a multipart operation

confirm.description: Must be true after explicit user confirmation

files.description: Multipart operations only: field name → local file path, or list of paths for array fields

headers.description: Headers declared by the operation (If-Match, Idempotency-Key)

query.description: Query parameters. Arrays are sent as repeated name[] values.

save_to.description: Local file path where the response body is written instead of being returned

name: call_operation
